value.rationale: Natural exact rank and word-length invariants for the first nontrivial matrix case sharply quantify how the unnormalized characteristic-two analogue fails a recent full-endomorphism generation theorem. The theorem gives a full arbitrary-field structure statement and exact counts for all even prime-power coefficient fields, not an isolated q=2 computer calculation. The rank-three gap and uniform length-two closure are structural.
